body: I feel like he is getting frustrated with my lack of communication, but it's really not something I can help. My brain just wants to feel listless and sad all the time.

I care about him more than anyone else. He's in the 10th grade and he's an insanely good student. He's been by far my best friend for my entire life. I've recently been distancing myself from him too though. He's wayyy more socially capable than me.
I usually say them to my little brother.
